title: fsl_sbca
description: Performs seed-based correlation analysis on FMRI data using either a single seed coordinate or a seed mask

seed.description: Seed voxel coordinate or file name of seed mask (3D/4D file)
seed.title: Seed File

target.description: File name of target mask(s) (3D or 4D file)
target.title: Target File

reg_flag.description: Perform time series regression rather than classification to targets
reg_flag.title: Time Series Regression Flag

conf_files.description: File name (or comma-separated list of file names) for confound ASCII text files
conf_files.title: Confound Files

seed_data.description: File name of 4D data file for the seed
seed_data.title: Seed Data File

binarise_flag.description: Binarise spatial maps prior to calculation of time courses
binarise_flag.title: Binarise Spatial Maps Flag

mean_flag.description: Use mean instead of Eigenvariates for calculation of time courses
mean_flag.title: Use Mean for Time Courses Flag

abs_cc_flag.description: Use maximum absolute value instead of maximum value of the cross-correlations
abs_cc_flag.title: Absolute Cross-Correlation Flag
